evidence: Encoder cost (RTX 5090 GPU-hours) and language cost (H100 GPU-hours) live in separate accounting paths and are never combined: encoder cost via v_cost_ratio/encoder_run_summary (provisioned encoder-worker-seconds, from readiness with separate cold-start), language cost via current_llm_summary.gpu_hours and v_pool_cost total_from_order_ws (from order). The two use different billing instants (readiness vs order) and different hardware classes, consistent with baselines.tex:19,29-30 that the classes are never summed. No view sums the two.
